name: D-Dimer Fast Test Kit
shortDescription: Quantitative determination of D-Dimer using the DX 101 Immunofluorescence Quantitative Analyzer.
intendedUse: quantitative determination of D-Dimer in human plasma or whole blood samples. The test is used as an aid in the assessment and evaluation of patients suspected of deep-vein thrombosis or pulmonary embolism.
